data.narrative:
Scale AI is a Series B AI & Software company with a last post-money valuation of $29.0B and $14.8B raised to date. The comparable universe comprises 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers including Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI, all at similar stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $29.0B base valuation with a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression to later stages, implying $55.1B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, Black Forest Labs at $3.2B, Field AI at $2.0B) yields a median valuation of $3.2B, with a range of $2.0B to $5.6B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods produces a low of $2.8B, median of $29.2B, and high of $63.4B. The wide dispersion reflects a material tension: peer multiples imply material downside to current valuation, while stage-progression mechanics suggest further upside. Key uncertainties include whether comparables at $2.0B–$5.6B truly reflect equivalent business quality and growth profiles, and whether the 1.9x multiplier appropriately captures progression dynamics for frontier-stage AI companies. The current $29.0B valuation sits at the median of the triangulated range, suggesting no clear directional bias from this two-method analysis alone.
